text.p: ONBANCorp, in reaction to a local news report, said it received a letter from its largest shareholder, Seymour Holtzman, demanding the company's board investigate his allegations against the company's directors.
The company said its board has formed a special committee of outside directors to investigate Holtzman's allegations.
The company did not specify the allegations in their statement.

However earlier The Syracuse Post-Standard stated that ONBANCorp is investigating charges that its top management mishandled company investments, doled out charitable contributions improperly and held non-business parties at the company's expense.
Company spokesmen were not available for further comment after repeated calls.
Holtzman threatened to sue the company if the board did not take action, the company said adding that it would have no further comment on the matter until the investigation was completed.
